description: Timed emergency pedal braking after 1 s of coasting from 80 km/h

criteria.rationale: 1 mJ floating-point allowance is far below the run energy scale; this checks software accounting, not physical calibration.

criteria.description: Stop within 30 m after pedal command
criteria.rationale: On level road mu=0.9, v0=80 km/h gives v²/(2 mu g) about 28 m without drag; 30 m allows Euler/event quantization, not reaction distance.
